column3: AN ACT TO AMEND THE CONSTITUTION OF THE
DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI  LANKA

column2: BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-

column3: This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Twenty  Second
Aritcle  99A  of  the  Constitution  of  the  Democratic

column2: Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka (hereinafter referred to as
“the Constitution”) is hereby amended as follows:-

column3: By  the  insertion  of  the  following  proviso
immediately  after  the  second  paragraph  of  this
Article:-
“Provided  that  each  political  party  and
independent  group  shall  include  not  less  than
50 per centum of women members in their list
under this Article.”
By  the  insertion  of  the  following  proviso
immediately  after  the  third  paragraph  of  this
Article:-
“Provided  that  the  Commissioner  of
Elections  shall  request  the  Secretary  of  such
recognized political party or group leader of such
independent group to nominate not less than 50
per centum of women members under this Article

to  represent  such  political  party  or 
the
independent group in Parliament.”
In the event of any inconsistency between the Sinhala

column2: and Tamil texts of this Act, the Sinhala text shall prevail.
